# Baseline

Baseline presents itself as usable without configuration on first install, with a refined layout, an organized interface and subtle animations. Colours, spacing and typography are all left open to adjustment for anyone who wants to go further. Its recorded description also claims mobile support of the same quality as on desktop.

![Baseline screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaaaalexis/obsidian-baseline/HEAD/baseline.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Baseline"
    author: "Alexis C"
    repo:   "aaaaalexis/obsidian-baseline"
    slug:   "baseline"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/baseline"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/aaaaalexis/obsidian-baseline"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaaaalexis/obsidian-baseline/HEAD/baseline.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Clean, modern, and polished from day one. Baseline feels effortless on first install. Refined layout, organized interface, subtle animations. When you're ready to go deeper, every detail is yours to shape: colors, spacing, typography, and beyond. And with first-class mobile support, the same quality experience follows you to every screen."
}
```
